description: This file defines the 'Coocook::Schema::Result::Unit' class, representing a database table 'units' with columns for id, project_id, short_name, and long_name. It includes relationships to other tables such as conversions, articles, dishes, recipes, and items, and provides methods for unit conversions and related operations.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Result::Unit
classes.description: Represents a unit of measurement within a project, with relationships to conversions, articles, dishes, recipes, and items, and methods for conversion operations.

methods.name: convertible_into
methods.description: Returns all units that the current unit can be converted into via conversions.

methods.name: find_conversion_into
methods.description: Finds a specific conversion between this unit and another unit by ID.
